title: Chapter 468 Ye Hui Is Seriously Injured
content:
Chapter 468 Ye Hui Is Seriously Injured

Wang Shuo naturally knew the horror of spider silk, and he had suffered a great loss from spider silk before.

But the current Wang Shuo is not the same Wang Shuo as before.

He moved quickly to avoid the attacking spider silk.

Anna could not tie Wang Shuo up, and she finally gave up the idea.

Wang Shuo rushed up again and fought with Queen Anna in close combat.

At this moment, the strongest king hiding in the army of the Parthian Empire secretly observed the battle situation and was ready to launch a sneak attack at any time.

The strongest king of the enemy deliberately stretched the battlefield wide.

As the fight went on, Wang Shuo found that there were only himself and the enemy around him.

Unknowingly, he had entered the center of the enemy.

Although fighting in the enemy army, the aftermath of the battle can kill some low-level soldiers, which can be said to be disadvantageous to the enemy.

For the strongest king, low-level soldiers are no different from ants.

It is very simple to get out of their encirclement, after all, the king can fly.

But Wang Shuo felt that something was wrong with this matter.

Because there were a few faint and looming auras of powerful people around.

Wang Shuo was ready to release his three pets at any time.

Among the enemies, three more strongest kings can definitely have an unexpected effect.

It can even play a decisive role in the battle situation.

At this moment, Wang Shuo saw Ye Hui stand up and fly quickly towards the city wall.

On the ground, the two strongest kings also flew up and chased Ye Hui.

"There is an ambush."

Wang Shuo vaguely heard Ye Hui say.

Looking at Queen Anna who was close at hand, Wang Shuo wondered if he could kill her if he united with three pets.

This thought kept flashing in Wang Shuo's mind.

But in the end, Wang Shuo gave up.

Queen Anna must have a way to save her life.

How could an old monster who has lived for thousands of years be killed so easily.

Wang Shuo thought of his absolute defense and resurrection coins.

At this time, other people in the camp also began to retreat to the city wall.

Suddenly, a spear as thick as an arm shot out from the enemy camp and aimed at Ye Hui.

Wang Shuo was shocked.

He was careless!

Andre was too shameless. He tricked Ye Hui off the city wall and then started to beat him up and attack him.

Now he was shooting cold arrows.

Come to think of it, if he killed the enemy's supreme commander, it would be at least half the victory, not to mention the immediate victory in combat power.

Wang Shuo wanted to get up and rescue.

"Hehehe, your opponent is me, don't be distracted!" Queen Anna turned into eight legs and looked like a monster.

When Ye Hui was about to enter the barrier, he was pierced by a spear and was seriously injured. His life and death were uncertain.

Wang Shuo and other kings also began to retreat.

In this battle of kings, the Frost Empire was completely defeated.

Ye Hui was seriously injured. Although he saved his life, he had no strength to fight again.

Except for the three Shuras, everyone else was seriously injured, and even the strongest king fell.

Wang Shuo guessed that the other party should be using the strategy of delaying against the three Shuras.

As for the king of the Frost Empire, they tried their best to kill him.

It must be said that this approach is quite clever.

The conventional siege battle unfolded, and countless shells fell on the barrier.

The appearance of this ultra-long-range weapon directly wiped out the absolute advantage of the defenders.

At this time, most people would choose to fight to the death with the other party under the city wall.

Of course, this is when both sides think they can win.

Listening to the crackling sound of shells, and watching Ye Hui's command in circles.

Wang Shuo couldn't help shaking his head.

It would be strange if this didn't fail!

Wang Shuo even felt that Ye Hui's command ability was not as good as Lin Dabiao and Ye Tianba's.

As for Ayub, there is no need to say more.
